The meeting must be scheduled for one hour between 9:00 and 17:00 on Monday, considering the participants' existing schedules and Pamela's preference not to meet after 14:30.

- Anthony is free during the following times on Monday: 9:00–9:30, 10:00–12:00, and 13:00–16:00 (but limited by Pamela's constraint to before 14:30).
- Pamela is free during: 9:00–9:30 and 10:00–14:30, but cannot meet after 14:30, so any meeting must end by 14:30.
- Zachary is free during: 11:30–12:00, 12:30–13:00, and 13:30–14:30.

The only one-hour slot where all three are available and Pamela's constraint is satisfied is 13:30 to 14:30:
- Anthony is free (no meetings between 13:00 and 16:00).
- Pamela is free (available until 14:30 and the meeting ends at 14:30, which is not after 14:30).
- Zachary is free (explicitly available from 13:30 to 14:30).

This slot works as it is within the work hours and respects all constraints.
